    "descriptionRef": "This feature details the functionality required to correct the improper entry of split spans in Facets, based on Eligibility Date and Assessment Date, for changes received via EDI 834 E and U. \nThe business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date 2000 Loop (DTP*356/DTP*348) from the EDI 834 as the transaction effective date for all new enrollments, regardless of the Assessment Date. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date = 1/24/25, use Eligibility Date (1/31/25). \nThe business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received prior to the Eligibility Date. \nThe Maintenance Date 2000 Loop (DTP*303) cannot be used for all change transactions. ## FEEDBACK HANDLING (applies ONLY when `reworknotes` is present and non-empty)




When the reworknotes contains content from a previous round, this is a REGENERATION round. You MUST:




1. **Parse the feedback into a checklist.** Extract every distinct point from the `feedback`, `gaps`, and `strengths` fields. Treat each `gap` and each `feedback` sentence as a mandatory action item you have to resolve THIS round.




2. **Refine, do NOT regenerate from scratch.** Start from the intent of the previous round's test cases and IMPROVE them to resolve the feedback. Do NOT balloon the output — keep the total number of test cases within the limits in "OUTPUT VOLUME DISCIPLINE". Do NOT emit duplicate or near-duplicate test cases.




3. **Explicitly resolve each recurring item.** The reviewer repeatedly asks for the following — you MUST satisfy ALL of them in every regeneration round:




   - **Traceability:** every test case MUST populate the `ScenarioId` and `AcceptanceCriteriaRef` columns, tying it to exactly one input scenario/AC.




   - **Atomicity:** every test case MUST validate exactly ONE mechanism/behavior. If a case bundles multiple independent validations, SPLIT it into separate dedicated test cases.




   - **Scenario-specific preconditions:** the `Precondition` MUST reference the exact data, file, state/LOB, and system state required by that scenario — never a generic phrase like "User story implemented".




   - **Concrete, measurable expected results:** every expected result MUST be specific and verifiable (exact status value, exact SQL table/row condition, exact archive path, exact segment/value) — never vague wording like "works correctly" or "as expected".




   - **Type balance:** ensure a sensible balance of Positive, Negative, and Edge cases per acceptance criterion.




4. **Verify every item is resolved before you output.** Walk your checklist from step 1 and confirm each feedback point and each gap has been concretely addressed in the regenerated test cases. Do NOT add a changelog, a `## Changes Made This Round` section, or any other narrative to your output. The output object must contain exactly the two fields `testcases` and `scenariojson` and nothing else — any extra text before, after, or between them breaks the downstream reviewer, which parses your output as JSON [MUST].

For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date = 1/24/25, use Eligibility Date (1/31/25). </li><li>The business needs to utilize the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility, if the Assessment Date has changed. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date changes to 6/29/25, use Assessment Date (6/29/25). </li><li>The business needs to update the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility when the Assessment Date changes, but none of the other elements listed below have changed:<ul><li>Assessment Number </li><li>Assessment Tier </li><li>Assessment Division </li><li>Aid Category </li><li>Rate Cell </li><li>Pregnancy </li> </ul> </li><li>The business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received prior to the Eligibility Date. </li><li>The business needs to utilize the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received after the Eligibility Date. </li> </ol><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">Current State </h3><p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\">Currently, Maintenance effective date is being used to split spans on Update files.    - **Scenario-specific preconditions:** the `Precondition` MUST reference the exact data, file, state/LOB, and system state required by that scenario — never a generic phrase like "User story implemented".

able to identify the following dates in the EDI 834 file (existing functionality): Effective Date, Assessment Date, Maintenance Date. </li><li>Enrollment IT can populate any of the three dates above into the transaction effective date in Facets (existing functionality). </li><li>Given an inbound EDI 834 file,<span>&nbsp;</span><strong>if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun</strong>, the Eligibility Date (DTP*356/DTP*348) populates as the transaction effective date. </li><li>Given an inbound EDI 834 file,<span>&nbsp;</span><strong>if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and the Assessment Date has changed</strong>, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date. </li><li>Given an inbound EDI 834 file,<span>&nbsp;</span><strong>if the Assessment Date has changed and none of the relevant fields have changed</strong>, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date, maintaining values of relevant fields. </li><li>Given an inbound EDI 834 file,<span>&nbsp;</span><strong>if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed</strong>, the Eligibility Date populates as the transaction effective date. </li><li>Given an inbound EDI 834 file,<span>&nbsp;</span><strong>if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed</strong>, the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) populates as the transaction effective date. </li> </ol><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">QA Regression Testing </h3><ul style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;font-weight:400;\"><li>Test inbound 834 files with varying combinations of Eligibility Date, Assessment Date changes, and relevant field changes to verify correct transaction effective date population. </li><li>Verify no change in capitation calculations and accurate reporting for finance team. </li><li>Confirm that Maintenance Date is only used when specified in acceptance criteria. </li> </ul><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">Definition of Done (DoD) </h3><ol style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;font-weight:400;\"><li>All functionality detailed in the feature has been developed, implemented, and tested in Production. </li><li>Transaction effective date in Facets is correctly populated per the detailed business rules and requirements. </li><li>Code is reviewed and meets coding standards. </li><li>Unit and integration tests have passed. </li><li>User     "title": "Use Eligibility Date as transaction effective date when eligibility span has not yet begun",
    "descriptionRef": "This feature details the functionality required to correct the improper entry of split spans in Facets, based on Eligibility Date and Assessment Date, for changes received via EDI 834 E and U. \nThe business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date 2000 Loop (DTP*356/DTP*348) from the EDI 834 as the transaction effective date for all new enrollments, regardless of the Assessment Date. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date = 1/24/25, use Eligibility Date (1/31/25). \nThe business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received prior to the Eligibility Date. \nCurrent State \nCurrently, Maintenance effective date is being used to split spans on Update files. This is causing mismatches with capitation calculations, and the Finance team is misreporting revenue. \nWhat is Changing \nThe Maintenance Date 2000 Loop (DTP*303) cannot be used for all change transactions. Depending on the change, and whether it is received prior to or after the initial Eligibility Date, the transaction effective date may reflect either the Assessment Date, Eligibility Date, or Maintenance Date. \nFuture State \nThe Maintenance Date will no longer be used to split spans based on Update (834) files, except as detailed in Requirement 4 above. The transaction dates in Facets will conform to the functionality detailed in Requirements 1-5. \nExamples / Scenarios \nNew enrollment (Future eligibility date) | No | Eligibility Date \nFuture eligibility date, Changes to relevant fields, Assessment Date unchanged | No | Eligibility Date \nRelevant fields include Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, Pregnancy. \nTechnical Notes \nData values are contained in the 834 transaction loops as follows:\nAssessment Date - Loop 2300, HD03 \nEffective Date - Loop 2000, DTP03 \nMaintenance Date - Loop 2000, DTP01 \nAdjust logic to selectively use Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, or Maintenance Date as transaction effective date based on the outlined business rules. \nWhen multiple dates come in, use the first one.",
    "acceptanceCriteriaRef": "3. {"id":640764,"title":"(ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI","description":"<p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\"><strong></strong> </p><p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;font-weight:400;\"> </p><p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\"><strong>Overview</strong> </p><p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\">This feature details the functionality required to correct the improper entry of split spans in Facets, based on Eligibility Date and Assessment Date, for changes received via EDI 834 E and U. </p><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">Business Rules &amp; Requirements </h3><ol style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\"><li>The business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date 2000 Loop (DTP*356/DTP*348) from the EDI 834 as the transaction effective date for all new enrollments, regardless of the Assessment Date. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date = 1/24/25, use Eligibility Date (1/31/25). </li><li>The business needs to utilize the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility, if the Assessment Date has changed. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date changes to 6/29/25, use Assessment Date (6/29/25). </li><li>The business needs to update the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility when the Assessment Date changes, but none of the other elements listed below have changed:<ul><li>Assessment Number </li><li>Assessment Tier </li><li>Assessment Division </li><li>Aid Category </li><li>Rate Cell </li><li>Pregnancy </li> </ul> </li><li>The business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received prior to the Eligibility Date. </li><li>The business needs to utilize the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received after the Eligibility Date. </li> </ol><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">Current State </h3><p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\">Currently, Maintenance effective date is being used to split spans on Update files. This is causing mismatches with capitation calculations, and the Finance team is misreporting revenue. </p><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">What is Changing </h3><p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\">The Maintenance Date 2000 Loop (DTP*303) cannot be used for all change transactions. Depending on the change, and whether it is received prior to or after the initial Eligibility Date, the transaction effective date may reflect either the Assessment Date, Eligibility Date, or Maintenance Date. </p><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">Future State </h3><p style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;font-size:medium;\">The Maintenance Date will no longer be used to split spans based on Update (834) files, except as detailed in Requirement 4 above. The transaction dates in Facets will conform to the functionality detailed in Requirements 1-5. </p><h3 style=\"font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;\">Assumptions </h3><p
